introHtml: Gpromomart seat covers offer a durable, full-color dye-sub finish that stands out at trade shows and corporate events. Designed for standard 6- and 8-foot tables, these polyester covers provide a wrinkle-resistant fit with vibrant, edge-to-edge graphics. Whether you need flat 3-sided covers or economy table throws, Gpromomart’s lineup ensures your brand message is front and center. Order in bulk for consistent branding across all your event setups.
